title: Semantic-TVM: Structure-Preserving Trustworthy Virtual Memory for Memory-Augmented and Tool-Using Agents
abstract: arXiv:2609.15011v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Memory-augmented and tool-using agents expose exact private values when remote LLMs process retrieved memory, tool actions, and intermediate observations. One-way masking limits direct exposure but removes values needed for trusted execution and can leak them through later observations. We propose Trustworthy Virtual Memory (TVM), a closed-loop runtime that keeps exact-value state local while presenting a protected view to the remote model. Within this single runtime, Rule-TVM replaces whole protected fields with locally recoverable handles, and Semantic-TVM instead replaces only sensitive spans predicted by a trusted local model, preserving surrounding task-relevant context. On Memory-EHR and Memory-RAP across two providers, span-level projection recovers most of the EHR utility lost under whole-field replacement (Task Success 84.17% vs. 52.33% on DeepSeek) while measured exposure stays low and workflows remain executable.

translated_title: Semantic-TVM：面向记忆增强与工具使用智能体的结构保持型可信虚拟内存
translated_abstract: 记忆增强与工具使用型智能体在远程大语言模型处理检索到的记忆、工具动作和中间观察结果时，会暴露确切的隐私数值。单向掩码虽然限制了直接暴露，但会移除可信执行所需的数值，并可能通过后续观察造成泄露。我们提出了可信虚拟内存（TVM），这是一种闭环运行时，将精确值状态保留在本地，同时向远程模型呈现受保护的视图。在这一单一运行时中，Rule-TVM 用本地可恢复的句柄替换整个受保护字段，而 Semantic-TVM 则仅替换由可信本地模型预测出的敏感片段，从而保留周围与任务相关的上下文。在两个提供商的 Memory-EHR 和 Memory-RAP 基准上，片段级投影恢复了整字段替换所损失的大部分电子健康记录（EHR）任务效用（在 DeepSeek 上任务成功率为 84.17% 对 52.33%），同时测得的暴露程度保持在低水平，且工作流程仍然可执行。
tldr: Semantic-TVM 提出可信虚拟内存（TVM）闭环运行时，利用可信本地模型仅替换预测出的敏感片段而非整个字段，在隐私暴露保持低水平的同时恢复了大部分任务效用，解决了记忆增强与工具使用智能体在远程 LLM 处理过程中的隐私泄露问题。
en_tdlr: Semantic-TVM introduces Trustworthy Virtual Memory (TVM), a closed-loop runtime where a trusted local model replaces only predicted sensitive spans instead of entire fields, recovering most task utility while keeping measured exposure low for memory-augmented and tool-using agents processing data with remote LLMs.
